system.description:
Your magic didn't come from a bloodline: it tore through you in a moment of extremity. You survived. The magic stayed. It is most common in the Sundered Reach and the land around the Maw, where the Shattering tore the Weave.

  • Bloodline Cantrips: Thorn Whip and Mage Hand.
  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Once per day, when the GM rolls on the Corruption Table for you, you may have the d100 rolled again; the second result stands. You have Advantage on saves against mind-affecting effects: the trauma made you resilient in ways others are not.
  • Bloodline Awakening (10th): Once per day, the force of your awakening erupts outward in a 30ft radius.
  • Each other creature within 30ft makes a Will save or is Stunned until the end of your next turn and takes 5d8 psychic damage (half on a success).
  • A creature that fails by 5 or more attacks its nearest ally for 1 round after the Stun ends.
  • You also have Advantage on saves against being Stunned or Paralysed.
